Title:
Hyperbolicity of the moduli of certain Fano threefolds
Authors:
Philipp Licht
View PDF
HTML (experimental)
Abstract:
We prove the Shafarevich conjecture for Fano threefolds of Picard rank 1, index 1 and degree 4.
